physicalNotes: Radius 0.744 Jupiter radii from Hartman et al. 2024 (2024AJ....168..202H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..202H/abstract): 53,190 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.251 Jupiter masses (Hartman et al. 2024, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2024AJ....168..202H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..202H/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.period: Hartman et al. 2024 (2024AJ....168..202H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HARTMAN_ET_AL_2024): P 3.4716826 d

sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
